name: Cartographer
description: Records each new map sector reached while completing tasks and builds a route journal.
mechanic: Records each new map sector reached while completing tasks and builds a route journal.
winCondition: Map a configured number of distinct route segments.

name: Auditor
description: Audits task completions since the previous checkpoint and earns a bonus vote when progress is found.
mechanic: Audits task completions since the previous checkpoint and earns a bonus vote when progress is found.
winCondition: Correctly flag a configured number of inconsistent progress reports.

name: Relay
description: Decodes one signal for every two completed tasks.
mechanic: Decodes one signal for every two completed tasks.
winCondition: Decode the required number of team signals.

name: Quartermaster
description: Unlocks a one-use emergency meeting call after completing four tasks.
mechanic: Unlocks a one-use emergency meeting call after completing four tasks.
winCondition: Allocate every token before the final meeting.

name: Surveyor
description: Builds a survey from distinct task types and map sectors.
mechanic: Builds a survey from distinct task types and map sectors.
winCondition: Submit a configured number of accurate room-change reports.

name: Courier
description: Records each completed task as a delivery in a personal ledger.
mechanic: Records each completed task as a delivery in a personal ledger.
winCondition: Deliver the required number of packets.

name: Archivist
description: Maintains a rolling event ledger of task completions and meetings.
mechanic: Maintains a rolling event ledger of task completions and meetings.
winCondition: Verify a configured number of event-order questions.

name: Beaconist
description: Charges a beacon for every two completed tasks and can claim a bonus vote when charged.
mechanic: Charges a beacon for every two completed tasks and can claim a bonus vote when charged.
winCondition: Record traffic at the required number of distinct rooms.

name: Mediator
description: Earns one bonus vote at the first meeting after completing three tasks.
mechanic: Earns one bonus vote at the first meeting after completing three tasks.
winCondition: Complete a configured number of polls.

name: Calibrator
description: Earns a bonus vote at a meeting after completing the same task type twice in a row.
mechanic: Earns a bonus vote at a meeting after completing the same task type twice in a row.
winCondition: Calibrate the required number of consoles.

name: Signalwright
description: Earns a bonus vote at a meeting after completing three different task types consecutively.
mechanic: Earns a bonus vote at a meeting after completing three different task types consecutively.
winCondition: Create the required number of successful console links.

name: Timekeeper
description: Stores task-count checkpoints and compares progress between snapshots.
mechanic: Stores task-count checkpoints and compares progress between snapshots.
winCondition: Make the required number of accurate progress comparisons.

name: Counterfeiter
description: Plants a decoy task-board entry in a private ledger and tracks each report token.
mechanic: Plants a decoy task-board entry in a private ledger and tracks each report token.
winCondition: Keep the forged entry undiscovered through the configured checkpoint.

name: Echoist
description: Emits a signal cue and records each echo in a private event ledger.
mechanic: Emits a signal cue and records each echo in a private event ledger.
winCondition: Trigger the required number of distinct cues without being identified.

name: Blackout Artist
description: Applies an eight-second dark visual filter to its character display, then restores its normal appearance.
mechanic: Applies an eight-second dark visual filter to its character display, then restores its normal appearance.
winCondition: Cause the required number of incorrect room-symbol reports.

name: Broker
description: Receives one additional vote at every meeting and records each clue-trade activation.
mechanic: Receives one additional vote at every meeting and records each clue-trade activation.
winCondition: Complete the configured number of clue exchanges.

name: Decoyist
description: Repositions to a nearby player to create a decoy movement pattern.
mechanic: Repositions to a nearby player to create a decoy movement pattern.
winCondition: Lead the crew to inspect the configured number of false markers.

name: Ledgerist
description: Stores task-ledger checkpoints and tracks each delayed refresh window.
mechanic: Stores task-ledger checkpoints and tracks each delayed refresh window.
winCondition: Create the required number of stale-board windows.

name: Switchboarder
description: Swaps positions with the nearest player using a networked position exchange.
mechanic: Swaps positions with the nearest player using a networked position exchange.
winCondition: Cause the required number of panel-label mix-ups.

name: Weathermaker
description: Changes its character's visual palette for eight seconds.
mechanic: Changes its character's visual palette for eight seconds.
winCondition: Activate the required number of distinct room conditions.

name: Misdirector
description: Can return to its previous meeting checkpoint to confuse movement tracking.
mechanic: Can return to its previous meeting checkpoint to confuse movement tracking.
winCondition: Publish the configured number of misleading statistical summaries.

name: Scrambler
description: Reverses its recorded event ledger to scramble the displayed sequence.
mechanic: Reverses its recorded event ledger to scramble the displayed sequence.
winCondition: Cause the required number of incorrect panel interpretations.

name: Parasitic Signal
description: Attaches a visible signal outline to a nearby player for a short duration.
mechanic: Attaches a visible signal outline to a nearby player for a short duration.
winCondition: Keep the configured number of false tags active until they expire.

name: Jigsaw
description: Collects one pattern fragment for each distinct task type completed.
mechanic: Collects one pattern fragment for each distinct task type completed.
winCondition: Assemble the complete pattern before the match ends.

name: Pilgrim
description: Builds a route by completing different task types without repeating the previous one.
mechanic: Builds a route by completing different task types without repeating the previous one.
winCondition: Visit the full landmark sequence in order.

name: Curator
description: Catalogues each unique combination of task type and map sector.
mechanic: Catalogues each unique combination of task type and map sector.
winCondition: Catalogue the configured number of distinct room-state combinations.

name: Wayfinder
description: Builds a route by moving between map sectors; each sector transition is a route stop.
mechanic: Builds a route by moving between map sectors; each sector transition is a route stop.
winCondition: Complete the required number of route challenges.

name: Collector
description: Collects one artifact for each new map sector visited while completing tasks.
mechanic: Collects one artifact for each new map sector visited while completing tasks.
winCondition: Collect the required number of different artifacts.

name: Metronome
description: Maintains a rhythm sequence by completing tasks within a three-to-fifteen-second timing window.
mechanic: Maintains a rhythm sequence by completing tasks within a three-to-fifteen-second timing window.
winCondition: Complete the required number of rhythm sequences.

name: Cartouche
description: Collects distinct pairs of task types as matching symbols.
mechanic: Collects distinct pairs of task types as matching symbols.
winCondition: Match all assigned symbol pairs.

name: Lighthouse
description: Restores one beacon segment for every pair of completed tasks.
mechanic: Restores one beacon segment for every pair of completed tasks.
winCondition: Restore the signal chain for the required total duration.

name: Weathervane
description: Builds prediction progress by maintaining a sequence of alternating task types.
mechanic: Builds prediction progress by maintaining a sequence of alternating task types.
winCondition: Make the required number of correct condition predictions.

name: Puzzlewright
description: Solves its logic sequence by avoiding consecutive repeats of the same task type.
mechanic: Solves its logic sequence by avoiding consecutive repeats of the same task type.
winCondition: Solve the complete logic grid.

name: Time Capsule
description: Compares task-count snapshots to measure progress between checkpoints.
mechanic: Compares task-count snapshots to measure progress between checkpoints.
winCondition: Complete the required number of before-and-after comparisons.

name: Nomad
description: Builds an itinerary score by returning to previously visited sectors after leaving them.
mechanic: Builds an itinerary score by returning to previously visited sectors after leaving them.
winCondition: Reach the itinerary score threshold before the match ends.
